opening.argument: The speaker promotes participation in BitClub Network through paid referrals and binary-team placement. He describes a participant being "paid ... 99 dollars which was registered on your referral" [1], instructs viewers to open the account’s "MyTeam tab, then Binari 3" [2], and connects placing participants with marketing benefits [3]. He also refers to "the target of 8% of the weak leg" [4]. Alongside these recruitment and placement activities, the displayed material describes Bitcoin cycle payouts and matching bonuses through sponsorship levels [5]. These facts establish the promoted structure and its payout claims, while the records do not establish actual returns, participant outcomes, or the accuracy of those claims.
